1: #===============================================================================
2: # NOTE: In Gen 7+, the Day Care is replaced by the Pokémon Nursery, which works
3: #       in much the same way except deposited Pokémon no longer gain Exp because
4: #       of the player walking around and, in Gen 8+, deposited Pokémon are able
5: #       to learn egg moves from each other if they are the same species. In
6: #       Essentials, this code can be used for both facilities, and these
7: #       mechanics differences are set by some Settings.
8: # NOTE: The Day Care has a different price than the Pokémon Nursery. For the Day
9: #       Care, you are charged when you withdraw a deposited Pokémon and you pay
10: #       an amount based on how many levels it gained. For the Nursery, you pay
11: #       $500 up-front when you deposit a Pokémon. This difference will appear in
12: #       the Day Care Lady's event, not in these scripts.
13: #===============================================================================
14: class DayCare
15:   #=============================================================================
16:   # Code that generates an egg based on two given Pokémon.
17:   #=============================================================================
18:   module EggGenerator
19:     module_function
20: 
21:     def generate(mother, father)
22:       # Determine which Pokémon is the mother and which is the father
23:       # Ensure mother is female, if the pair contains a female
24:       # Ensure father is male, if the pair contains a male
25:       # Ensure father is genderless, if the pair is a genderless with Ditto
26:       if mother.male? || father.female? || mother.genderless?
27:         mother, father = father, mother
28:       end
29:       mother_data = [mother, mother.species_data.egg_groups.include?(:Ditto)]
30:       father_data = [father, father.species_data.egg_groups.include?(:Ditto)]
31:       # Determine which parent the egg's species is based from
32:       species_parent = (mother_data[1]) ? father : mother
33:       # Determine the egg's species
34:       baby_species = determine_egg_species(species_parent.species, mother, father)
35:       mother_data.push(mother.species_data.breeding_can_produce?(baby_species))
36:       father_data.push(father.species_data.breeding_can_produce?(baby_species))
37:       # Generate egg
38:       egg = generate_basic_egg(baby_species)
39:       # Inherit properties from parent(s)
40:       inherit_form(egg, species_parent, mother_data, father_data)
41:       inherit_nature(egg, mother, father)
42:       inherit_ability(egg, mother_data, father_data)
43:       inherit_moves(egg, mother_data, father_data)
44:       inherit_IVs(egg, mother, father)
45:       inherit_poke_ball(egg, mother_data, father_data)
46:       # Calculate other properties of the egg
47:       set_shininess(egg, mother, father)   # Masuda method and Shiny Charm
48:       set_pokerus(egg)
49:       # Recalculate egg's stats
50:       egg.calc_stats
51:       return egg
52:     end
53: 
54:     def determine_egg_species(parent_species, mother, father)
55:       ret = GameData::Species.get(parent_species).get_baby_species(true, mother.item_id, father.item_id)
56:       # Check for alternate offspring (i.e. Nidoran M/F, Volbeat/Illumise, Manaphy/Phione)
57:       offspring = GameData::Species.get(ret).offspring
58:       ret = offspring.sample if offspring.length > 0
59:       return ret
60:     end
61: 
62:     def generate_basic_egg(species)
63:       egg = Pokemon.new(species, Settings::EGG_LEVEL)
64:       egg.name           = _INTL("Egg")
65:       egg.steps_to_hatch = egg.species_data.hatch_steps
66:       egg.obtain_text    = _INTL("Day-Care Couple")
67:       egg.happiness      = 120
68:       egg.form           = 0 if species == :SINISTEA
69:       # Set regional form
70:       new_form = MultipleForms.call("getFormOnEggCreation", egg)
71:       egg.form = new_form if new_form
72:       return egg
73:     end
74: 
75:     def inherit_form(egg, species_parent, mother, father)
76:       # mother = [mother, mother_ditto, mother_in_family]
77:       # father = [father, father_ditto, father_in_family]
78:       # Inherit form from the parent that determined the egg's species
79:       if species_parent.species_data.has_flag?("InheritFormFromMother")
80:         egg.form = species_parent.form
81:       end
82:       # Inherit form from a parent holding an Ever Stone
83:       [mother, father].each do |parent|
84:         next if !parent[2]   # Parent isn't a related species to the egg
85:         next if !parent[0].species_data.has_flag?("InheritFormWithEverStone")
86:         next if !parent[0].hasItem?(:EVERSTONE)
87:         egg.form = parent[0].form
88:         break
89:       end
90:     end
91: 
92:     def get_moves_to_inherit(egg, mother, father)
93:       # mother = [mother, mother_ditto, mother_in_family]
94:       # father = [father, father_ditto, father_in_family]
95:       move_father = (father[1]) ? mother[0] : father[0]
96:       move_mother = (father[1]) ? father[0] : mother[0]
97:       moves = []
98:       # Get level-up moves known by both parents
99:       egg.getMoveList.each do |move|
100:         next if move[0] <= egg.level   # Could already know this move by default
101:         next if !mother[0].hasMove?(move[1]) || !father[0].hasMove?(move[1])
102:         moves.push(move[1])
103:       end
104:       # Inherit Machine moves from father (or non-Ditto genderless parent)
105:       if Settings::BREEDING_CAN_INHERIT_MACHINE_MOVES && !move_father.female?
106:         GameData::Item.each do |i|
107:           move = i.move
108:           next if !move
109:           next if !move_father.hasMove?(move) || !egg.compatible_with_move?(move)
110:           moves.push(move)
111:         end
112:       end
113:       # Inherit egg moves from each parent
114:       if !move_father.female?
115:         egg.species_data.egg_moves.each do |move|
116:           moves.push(move) if move_father.hasMove?(move)
117:         end
118:       end
119:       if Settings::BREEDING_CAN_INHERIT_EGG_MOVES_FROM_MOTHER && move_mother.female?
120:         egg.species_data.egg_moves.each do |move|
121:           moves.push(move) if move_mother.hasMove?(move)
122:         end
123:       end
124:       # Learn Volt Tackle if a parent has a Light Ball and is in the Pichu family
125:       if egg.species == :PICHU && GameData::Move.exists?(:VOLTTACKLE) &&
126:          ((father[2] && father[0].hasItem?(:LIGHTBALL)) ||
127:           (mother[2] && mother[0].hasItem?(:LIGHTBALL)))
128:         moves.push(:VOLTTACKLE)
129:       end
130:       return moves
131:     end
132: 
133:     def inherit_moves(egg, mother, father)
134:       moves = get_moves_to_inherit(egg, mother, father)
135:       # Remove duplicates (keeping the latest ones)
136:       moves = moves.reverse
137:       moves |= []   # remove duplicates
138:       moves = moves.reverse
139:       # Learn moves
140:       first_move_index = moves.length - Pokemon::MAX_MOVES
141:       first_move_index = 0 if first_move_index < 0
142:       (first_move_index...moves.length).each { |i| egg.learn_move(moves[i]) }
143:     end
144: 
145:     def inherit_nature(egg, mother, father)
146:       new_natures = []
147:       new_natures.push(mother.nature) if mother.hasItem?(:EVERSTONE)
148:       new_natures.push(father.nature) if father.hasItem?(:EVERSTONE)
149:       return if new_natures.empty?
150:       egg.nature = new_natures.sample
151:     end
152: 
153:     # The female parent (or the non-Ditto parent) can pass down its Hidden
154:     # Ability (60% chance) or its regular ability (80% chance).
155:     # NOTE: This is how ability inheritance works in Gen 6+. Gen 5 is more
156:     #       restrictive, and even works differently between BW and B2W2, and I
157:     #       don't think that is worth adding in. Gen 4 and lower don't have
158:     #       ability inheritance at all, and again, I'm not bothering to add that
159:     #       in.
160:     def inherit_ability(egg, mother, father)
161:       # mother = [mother, mother_ditto, mother_in_family]
162:       # father = [father, father_ditto, father_in_family]
163:       parent = (mother[1]) ? father[0] : mother[0]   # The female or non-Ditto parent
164:       if parent.hasHiddenAbility?
165:         egg.ability_index = parent.ability_index if rand(100) < 60
166:       elsif rand(100) < 80
167:         egg.ability_index = parent.ability_index
168:       else
169:         egg.ability_index = (parent.ability_index + 1) % 2
170:       end
171:     end
172: 
173:     def inherit_IVs(egg, mother, father)
174:       # Get all stats
175:       stats = []
176:       GameData::Stat.each_main { |s| stats.push(s.id) }
177:       # Get the number of stats to inherit (includes ones inherited via Power items)
178:       inherit_count = 3
179:       if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
180:         inherit_count = 5 if mother.hasItem?(:DESTINYKNOT) || father.hasItem?(:DESTINYKNOT)
181:       end
182:       # Inherit IV because of Power items (if both parents have the same Power
183:       # item, then the parent that passes that Power item's stat down is chosen
184:       # randomly)
185:       power_items = [
186:         [:POWERWEIGHT, :HP],
187:         [:POWERBRACER, :ATTACK],
188:         [:POWERBELT,   :DEFENSE],
189:         [:POWERLENS,   :SPECIAL_ATTACK],
190:         [:POWERBAND,   :SPECIAL_DEFENSE],
191:         [:POWERANKLET, :SPEED]
192:       ]
193:       power_stats = {}
194:       [mother, father].each do |parent|
195:         power_items.each do |item|
196:           next if !parent.hasItem?(item[0])
197:           power_stats[item[1]] ||= []
198:           power_stats[item[1]].push(parent.iv[item[1]])
199:           break
200:         end
201:       end
202:       power_stats.each_pair do |stat, new_stats|
203:         next if !new_stats || new_stats.length == 0
204:         new_stat = new_stats.sample
205:         egg.iv[stat] = new_stat
206:         stats.delete(stat)   # Don't try to inherit this stat's IV again
207:         inherit_count -= 1
208:       end
209:       # Inherit the rest of the IVs
210:       chosen_stats = stats.sample(inherit_count)
211:       chosen_stats.each { |stat| egg.iv[stat] = [mother, father].sample.iv[stat] }
212:     end
213: 
214:     # Poké Balls can only be inherited from parents that are related to the
215:     # egg's species.
216:     # NOTE: This is how Poké Ball inheritance works in Gen 7+. Gens 5 and lower
217:     #       don't have Poké Ball inheritance at all. In Gen 6, only a female
218:     #       parent can pass down its Poké Ball. I don't think it's worth adding
219:     #       in these variations on the mechanic.
220:     # NOTE: The official games treat Nidoran M/F and Volbeat/Illumise as
221:     #       unrelated for the purpose of this mechanic. Essentials treats them
222:     #       as related and allows them to pass down their Poké Balls.
223:     def inherit_poke_ball(egg, mother, father)
224:       # mother = [mother, mother_ditto, mother_in_family]
225:       # father = [father, father_ditto, father_in_family]
226:       balls = []
227:       [mother, father].each do |parent|
228:         balls.push(parent[0].poke_ball) if parent[2]
229:       end
230:       balls.delete(:MASTERBALL)    # Can't inherit this Ball
231:       balls.delete(:CHERISHBALL)   # Can't inherit this Ball
232:       egg.poke_ball = balls.sample if !balls.empty?
233:     end
234: 
235:     # NOTE: There is a bug in Gen 8 that skips the original generation of an
236:     #       egg's personal ID if the Masuda Method/Shiny Charm can cause any
237:     #       rerolls. Essentials doesn't have this bug, meaning eggs are slightly
238:     #       more likely to be shiny (in Gen 8+ mechanics) than in Gen 8 itself.
239:     def set_shininess(egg, mother, father)
240:       shiny_retries = 0
241:       if father.owner.language != mother.owner.language
242:         shiny_retries += (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 8) ? 6 : 5
243:       end
244:       shiny_retries += 2 if $bag.has?(:SHINYCHARM)
245:       return if shiny_retries == 0
246:       shiny_retries.times do
247:         break if egg.shiny?
248:         egg.shiny = nil   # Make it recalculate shininess
249:         egg.personalID = rand(2**16) | (rand(2**16) << 16)
250:       end
251:     end
252: 
253:     def set_pokerus(egg)
254:       egg.givePokerus if rand(65_536) < Settings::POKERUS_CHANCE
255:     end
256:   end

258:   #=============================================================================
259:   # A slot in the Day Care, which can contain a Pokémon.
260:   #=============================================================================
261:   class DayCareSlot
262:     attr_reader :pokemon
263: 
264:     def initialize
265:       reset
266:     end
267: 
268:     def reset
269:       @pokemon = nil
270:       @initial_level = 0
271:     end
272: 
273:     def deposit(pkmn)
274:       @pokemon = pkmn
275:       @pokemon.heal
276:       @pokemon.form = 0 if @pokemon.isSpecies?(:SHAYMIN)
277:       @initial_level = pkmn.level
278:     end
279: 
280:     def filled?
281:       return !@pokemon.nil?
282:     end
283: 
284:     def pokemon_name
285:       return (filled?) ? @pokemon.name : ""

306:     def add_exp(amount = 1)

309:       return if @pokemon.exp >= max_exp

311:       @pokemon.exp += amount
312:       return if @pokemon.level == old_level
313:       @pokemon.calc_stats
314:       move_list = @pokemon.getMoveList

365:     egg_moves2 = pkmn2.species_data.get_egg_moves

373:     end

379:         learner[0].learn_move(learner[1])

471:     when 1

473:     else

478:         next if !choice_text

484:       $game_variables[choice_var] = (command == commands.length - 1) ? -1 : indices[command]

503:     pkmn2 = nil
504:     @slots.each do |slot|
505:       next if !slot.filled?
506:       if pkmn1.nil?
507:         pkmn1 = slot.pokemon
508:       else
509:         pkmn2 = slot.pokemon
510:       end
511:     end
512:     raise _INTL("Couldn't find 2 deposited Pokémon.") if pkmn2.nil?
513:     return pkmn1, pkmn2
514:   end

516:   def pokemon_in_ditto_egg_group?(pkmn)
517:     return pkmn.species_data.egg_groups.include?(:Ditto)
518:   end

520:   def compatible_gender?(pkmn1, pkmn2)
521:     return true if pkmn1.female? && pkmn2.male?
522:     return true if pkmn1.male? && pkmn2.female?
523:     ditto1 = pokemon_in_ditto_egg_group?(pkmn1)
524:     ditto2 = pokemon_in_ditto_egg_group?(pkmn2)
525:     return true if ditto1 && !ditto2
526:     return true if ditto2 && !ditto1
527:     return false
528:   end

530:   def compatibility
531:     return 0 if self.count != 2
532:     # Find the Pokémon whose compatibility is being calculated
533:     pkmn1, pkmn2 = pokemon_pair
534:     # Shadow Pokémon cannot breed
535:     return 0 if pkmn1.shadowPokemon? || pkmn2.shadowPokemon?
536:     # Pokémon in the Undiscovered egg group cannot breed
537:     egg_groups1 = pkmn1.species_data.egg_groups
538:     egg_groups2 = pkmn2.species_data.egg_groups
539:     return 0 if egg_groups1.include?(:Undiscovered) ||
540:                 egg_groups2.include?(:Undiscovered)
541:     # Pokémon that don't share an egg group (and neither is in the Ditto group)
542:     # cannot breed
543:     return 0 if !egg_groups1.include?(:Ditto) &&
544:                 !egg_groups2.include?(:Ditto) &&
545:                 (egg_groups1 & egg_groups2).length == 0
546:     # Pokémon with incompatible genders cannot breed
547:     return 0 if !compatible_gender?(pkmn1, pkmn2)
548:     # Pokémon can breed; calculate a compatibility factor
549:     ret = 1
550:     ret += 1 if pkmn1.species == pkmn2.species
551:     ret += 1 if pkmn1.owner.id != pkmn2.owner.id
552:     return ret
553:   end
554: end

43:   width  = spotpattern[0].length

51:       r = color.red + red
52:       g = color.green + green
53:       b = color.blue + blue
54:       color.red   = [[r, 0].max, 255].min
55:       color.green = [[g, 0].max, 255].min

57:       bitmap.set_pixel(xOrg, yOrg, color)
58:       bitmap.set_pixel(xOrg + 1, yOrg, color)
59:       bitmap.set_pixel(xOrg, yOrg + 1, color)
60:       bitmap.set_pixel(xOrg + 1, yOrg + 1, color)
61:     end
62:   end

142:   def update_shadow_moves
143:     return if !@shadow_moves || @shadow_moves.empty?

145:     if !shadowPokemon?
146:       if @shadow_moves.length > MAX_MOVES

155:     # Start with all Shadow moves
156:     new_moves = []
157:     @shadow_moves.each_with_index { |m, i| new_moves.push(m) if m && i < MAX_MOVES }
158:     num_shadow_moves = new_moves.length
159:     # Add some original moves (skipping ones in the same slot as a Shadow Move)
160:     num_original_moves = [3, 3, 2, 1, 1, 0][self.heartStage]
161:     if num_original_moves > 0

556: def pbClosestHiddenItem
557:   result = []
558:   playerX = $game_player.x
559:   playerY = $game_player.y
560:   $game_map.events.each_value do |event|
561:     next if !event.name[/hiddenitem/i]
562:     next if (playerX - event.x).abs >= 8
563:     next if (playerY - event.y).abs >= 6
564:     next if $game_self_switches[[$game_map.map_id, event.id, "A"]]
565:     result.push(event)
566:   end
567:   return nil if result.length == 0
568:   ret = nil
569:   retmin = 0
570:   result.each do |event|
571:     dist = (playerX - event.x).abs + (playerY - event.y).abs
572:     next if ret && retmin <= dist
573:     ret = event
574:     retmin = dist
575:   end
576:   return ret
577: end

580: # Teach and forget a move
581: #===============================================================================
582: def pbLearnMove(pkmn, move, ignore_if_known = false, by_machine = false, &block)
583:   return false if !pkmn
584:   move = GameData::Move.get(move).id
585:   if pkmn.egg? && !$DEBUG
586:     pbMessage(_INTL("Eggs can't be taught any moves."), &block)
587:     return false
588:   elsif pkmn.shadowPokemon?
589:     pbMessage(_INTL("Shadow Pokémon can't be taught any moves."), &block)
590:     return false
591:   end
592:   pkmn_name = pkmn.name
593:   move_name = GameData::Move.get(move).name
594:   if pkmn.hasMove?(move)
595:     pbMessage(_INTL("{1} already knows {2}.", pkmn_name, move_name), &block) if !ignore_if_known
596:     return false
597:   elsif pkmn.numMoves < Pokemon::MAX_MOVES
598:     pkmn.learn_move(move)
599:     pbMessage("\\se[]" + _INTL("{1} learned {2}!", pkmn_name, move_name) + "\\se[Pkmn move learnt]", &block)
600:     return true
601:   end
602:   pbMessage(_INTL("{1} wants to learn {2}, but it already knows {3} moves.",
603:                   pkmn_name, move_name, pkmn.numMoves.to_word) + "\1", &block)
604:   if pbConfirmMessage(_INTL("Should {1} forget a move to learn {2}?", pkmn_name, move_name), &block)
605:     loop do
606:       move_index = pbForgetMove(pkmn, move)
607:       if move_index >= 0
608:         old_move_name = pkmn.moves[move_index].name
609:         oldmovepp = pkmn.moves[move_index].pp
610:         pkmn.moves[move_index] = Pokemon::Move.new(move)   # Replaces current/total PP
611:         if by_machine && Settings::TAUGHT_MACHINES_KEEP_OLD_PP
612:           pkmn.moves[move_index].pp = [oldmovepp, pkmn.moves[move_index].total_pp].min
613:         end
614:         pbMessage(_INTL("1, 2, and...\\wt[16] ...\\wt[16] ...\\wt[16] Ta-da!") + "\\se[Battle ball drop]\1", &block)
615:         pbMessage(_INTL("{1} forgot how to use {2}.\\nAnd..." + "\1", pkmn_name, old_move_name), &block)
616:         pbMessage("\\se[]" + _INTL("{1} learned {2}!", pkmn_name, move_name) + "\\se[Pkmn move learnt]", &block)
617:         pkmn.changeHappiness("machine") if by_machine
618:         return true
619:       elsif pbConfirmMessage(_INTL("Give up on learning {1}?", move_name), &block)
620:         pbMessage(_INTL("{1} did not learn {2}.", pkmn_name, move_name), &block)
621:         return false
622:       end
623:     end
624:   else
625:     pbMessage(_INTL("{1} did not learn {2}.", pkmn_name, move_name), &block)
626:   end
627:   return false
628: end

3:   # Gaining Experience
4:   #=============================================================================
5:   def pbGainExp
6:     # Play wild victory music if it's the end of the battle (has to be here)
7:     @scene.pbWildBattleSuccess if wildBattle? && pbAllFainted?(1) && !pbAllFainted?(0)
8:     return if !@internalBattle || !@expGain
9:     # Go through each battler in turn to find the Pokémon that participated in
10:     # battle against it, and award those Pokémon Exp/EVs
11:     expAll = $player.has_exp_all || $bag.has?(:EXPALL)
12:     p1 = pbParty(0)
13:     @battlers.each do |b|
14:       next unless b&.opposes?   # Can only gain Exp from fainted foes
15:       next if b.participants.length == 0
16:       next unless b.fainted? || b.captured
17:       # Count the number of participants
18:       numPartic = 0
19:       b.participants.each do |partic|
20:         next unless p1[partic]&.able? && pbIsOwner?(0, partic)
21:         numPartic += 1
22:       end
23:       # Find which Pokémon have an Exp Share
24:       expShare = []
25:       if !expAll
26:         eachInTeam(0, 0) do |pkmn, i|
27:           next if !pkmn.able?
28:           next if !pkmn.hasItem?(:EXPSHARE) && GameData::Item.try_get(@initialItems[0][i]) != :EXPSHARE
29:           expShare.push(i)
30:         end
31:       end
32:       # Calculate EV and Exp gains for the participants
33:       if numPartic > 0 || expShare.length > 0 || expAll
34:         # Gain EVs and Exp for participants
35:         eachInTeam(0, 0) do |pkmn, i|
36:           next if !pkmn.able?
37:           next unless b.participants.include?(i) || expShare.include?(i)
38:           pbGainEVsOne(i, b)
39:           pbGainExpOne(i, b, numPartic, expShare, expAll, !pkmn.shadowPokemon?)
40:         end
41:         # Gain EVs and Exp for all other Pokémon because of Exp All
42:         if expAll
43:           showMessage = true
44:           eachInTeam(0, 0) do |pkmn, i|
45:             next if !pkmn.able?
46:             next if b.participants.include?(i) || expShare.include?(i)
47:             pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("Your other Pokémon also gained Exp. Points!")) if showMessage
48:             showMessage = false
49:             pbGainEVsOne(i, b)
50:             pbGainExpOne(i, b, numPartic, expShare, expAll, false)
51:           end
52:         end
53:       end
54:       # Clear the participants array
55:       b.participants = []
56:     end
57:   end

59:   def pbGainEVsOne(idxParty, defeatedBattler)
60:     pkmn = pbParty(0)[idxParty]   # The Pokémon gaining EVs from defeatedBattler
61:     evYield = defeatedBattler.pokemon.evYield
62:     # Num of effort points pkmn already has
63:     evTotal = 0
64:     GameData::Stat.each_main { |s| evTotal += pkmn.ev[s.id] }
65:     # Modify EV yield based on pkmn's held item
66:     if !Battle::ItemEffects.triggerEVGainModifier(pkmn.item, pkmn, evYield)
67:       Battle::ItemEffects.triggerEVGainModifier(@initialItems[0][idxParty], pkmn, evYield)
68:     end
69:     # Double EV gain because of Pokérus
70:     if pkmn.pokerusStage >= 1   # Infected or cured
71:       evYield.each_key { |stat| evYield[stat] *= 2 }
72:     end
73:     # Gain EVs for each stat in turn
74:     if pkmn.shadowPokemon? && pkmn.heartStage <= 3 && pkmn.saved_ev
75:       pkmn.saved_ev.each_value { |e| evTotal += e }
76:       GameData::Stat.each_main do |s|
77:         evGain = evYield[s.id].clamp(0, Pokemon::EV_STAT_LIMIT - pkmn.ev[s.id] - pkmn.saved_ev[s.id])
78:         evGain = evGain.clamp(0, Pokemon::EV_LIMIT - evTotal)
79:         pkmn.saved_ev[s.id] += evGain
80:         evTotal += evGain
81:       end
82:     else
83:       GameData::Stat.each_main do |s|
84:         evGain = evYield[s.id].clamp(0, Pokemon::EV_STAT_LIMIT - pkmn.ev[s.id])
85:         evGain = evGain.clamp(0, Pokemon::EV_LIMIT - evTotal)
86:         pkmn.ev[s.id] += evGain
87:         evTotal += evGain
88:       end
89:     end
90:   end

92:   def pbGainExpOne(idxParty, defeatedBattler, numPartic, expShare, expAll, showMessages = true)
93:     pkmn = pbParty(0)[idxParty]   # The Pokémon gaining Exp from defeatedBattler
94:     growth_rate = pkmn.growth_rate
95:     # Don't bother calculating if gainer is already at max Exp
96:     if pkmn.exp >= growth_rate.maximum_exp
97:       pkmn.calc_stats   # To ensure new EVs still have an effect
98:       return
99:     end
100:     isPartic    = defeatedBattler.participants.include?(idxParty)
101:     hasExpShare = expShare.include?(idxParty)
102:     level = defeatedBattler.level
103:     # Main Exp calculation
104:     exp = 0
105:     a = level * defeatedBattler.pokemon.base_exp
106:     if expShare.length > 0 && (isPartic || hasExpShare)
107:       if numPartic == 0   # No participants, all Exp goes to Exp Share holders
108:         exp = a / (Settings::SPLIT_EXP_BETWEEN_GAINERS ? expShare.length : 1)
109:       elsif Settings::SPLIT_EXP_BETWEEN_GAINERS   # Gain from participating and/or Exp Share
110:         exp = a / (2 * numPartic) if isPartic
111:         exp += a / (2 * expShare.length) if hasExpShare
112:       else   # Gain from participating and/or Exp Share (Exp not split)
113:         exp = (isPartic) ? a : a / 2
114:       end
115:     elsif isPartic   # Participated in battle, no Exp Shares held by anyone
116:       exp = a / (Settings::SPLIT_EXP_BETWEEN_GAINERS ? numPartic : 1)
117:     elsif expAll   # Didn't participate in battle, gaining Exp due to Exp All
118:       # NOTE: Exp All works like the Exp Share from Gen 6+, not like the Exp All
119:       #       from Gen 1, i.e. Exp isn't split between all Pokémon gaining it.
120:       exp = a / 2
121:     end
122:     return if exp <= 0
123:     # Pokémon gain more Exp from trainer battles
124:     exp = (exp * 1.5).floor if Settings::MORE_EXP_FROM_TRAINER_POKEMON && trainerBattle?
125:     # Scale the gained Exp based on the gainer's level (or not)
126:     if Settings::SCALED_EXP_FORMULA
127:       exp /= 5
128:       levelAdjust = ((2 * level) + 10.0) / (pkmn.level + level + 10.0)
129:       levelAdjust **= 5
130:       levelAdjust = Math.sqrt(levelAdjust)
131:       exp *= levelAdjust
132:       exp = exp.floor
133:       exp += 1 if isPartic || hasExpShare
134:     else
135:       exp /= 7
136:     end
137:     # Foreign Pokémon gain more Exp
138:     isOutsider = (pkmn.owner.id != pbPlayer.id ||
139:                  (pkmn.owner.language != 0 && pkmn.owner.language != pbPlayer.language))
140:     if isOutsider
141:       if pkmn.owner.language != 0 && pkmn.owner.language != pbPlayer.language
142:         exp = (exp * 1.7).floor
143:       else
144:         exp = (exp * 1.5).floor
145:       end
146:     end
147:     # Exp. Charm increases Exp gained
148:     exp = exp * 3 / 2 if $bag.has?(:EXPCHARM)
149:     # Modify Exp gain based on pkmn's held item
150:     i = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerExpGainModifier(pkmn.item, pkmn, exp)
151:     if i < 0
152:       i = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerExpGainModifier(@initialItems[0][idxParty], pkmn, exp)
153:     end
154:     exp = i if i >= 0
155:     # Boost Exp gained with high affection
156:     if Settings::AFFECTION_EFFECTS && @internalBattle && pkmn.affection_level >= 4 && !pkmn.mega?
157:       exp = exp * 6 / 5
158:       isOutsider = true   # To show the "boosted Exp" message
159:     end
160:     # Make sure Exp doesn't exceed the maximum
161:     expFinal = growth_rate.add_exp(pkmn.exp, exp)
162:     expGained = expFinal - pkmn.exp
163:     return if expGained <= 0
164:     # "Exp gained" message
165:     if showMessages
166:       if isOutsider
167:         pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} got a boosted {2} Exp. Points!", pkmn.name, expGained))
168:       else
169:         pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} got {2} Exp. Points!", pkmn.name, expGained))
170:       end
171:     end
172:     curLevel = pkmn.level
173:     newLevel = growth_rate.level_from_exp(expFinal)
174:     if newLevel < curLevel
175:       debugInfo = "Levels: #{curLevel}->#{newLevel} | Exp: #{pkmn.exp}->#{expFinal} | gain: #{expGained}"
176:       raise _INTL("{1}'s new level is less than its current level, which shouldn't happen.", pkmn.name) + "\n[#{debugInfo}]"
177:     end
178:     # Give Exp
179:     if pkmn.shadowPokemon?
180:       if pkmn.heartStage <= 3
181:         pkmn.exp += expGained
182:         $stats.total_exp_gained += expGained
183:       end
184:       return
185:     end
186:     $stats.total_exp_gained += expGained
187:     tempExp1 = pkmn.exp
188:     battler = pbFindBattler(idxParty)
189:     loop do   # For each level gained in turn...
190:       # EXP Bar animation
191:       levelMinExp = growth_rate.minimum_exp_for_level(curLevel)
192:       levelMaxExp = growth_rate.minimum_exp_for_level(curLevel + 1)
193:       tempExp2 = (levelMaxExp < expFinal) ? levelMaxExp : expFinal
194:       pkmn.exp = tempExp2
195:       @scene.pbEXPBar(battler, levelMinExp, levelMaxExp, tempExp1, tempExp2)
196:       tempExp1 = tempExp2
197:       curLevel += 1
198:       if curLevel > newLevel
199:         # Gained all the Exp now, end the animation
200:         pkmn.calc_stats
201:         battler&.pbUpdate(false)
202:         @scene.pbRefreshOne(battler.index) if battler
203:         break
204:       end
205:       # Levelled up
206:       pbCommonAnimation("LevelUp", battler) if battler
207:       oldTotalHP = pkmn.totalhp
208:       oldAttack  = pkmn.attack
209:       oldDefense = pkmn.defense
210:       oldSpAtk   = pkmn.spatk
211:       oldSpDef   = pkmn.spdef
212:       oldSpeed   = pkmn.speed
213:       battler.pokemon.changeHappiness("levelup") if battler&.pokemon
214:       pkmn.calc_stats
215:       battler&.pbUpdate(false)
216:       @scene.pbRefreshOne(battler.index) if battler
217:       pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} grew to Lv. {2}!", pkmn.name, curLevel)) { pbSEPlay("Pkmn level up") }
218:       @scene.pbLevelUp(pkmn, battler, oldTotalHP, oldAttack, oldDefense,
219:                        oldSpAtk, oldSpDef, oldSpeed)
220:       # Learn all moves learned at this level
221:       moveList = pkmn.getMoveList
222:       moveList.each { |m| pbLearnMove(idxParty, m[1]) if m[0] == curLevel }
223:     end
224:   end

226:   #=============================================================================
227:   # Learning a move
228:   #=============================================================================
229:   def pbLearnMove(idxParty, newMove)
230:     pkmn = pbParty(0)[idxParty]
231:     return if !pkmn
232:     pkmnName = pkmn.name
233:     battler = pbFindBattler(idxParty)
234:     moveName = GameData::Move.get(newMove).name
235:     # Pokémon already knows the move
236:     return if pkmn.hasMove?(newMove)
237:     # Pokémon has space for the new move; just learn it
238:     if pkmn.numMoves < Pokemon::MAX_MOVES
239:       pkmn.learn_move(newMove)
240:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} learned {2}!", pkmnName, moveName)) { pbSEPlay("Pkmn move learnt") }
241:       if battler
242:         battler.moves.push(Move.from_pokemon_move(self, pkmn.moves.last))
243:         battler.pbCheckFormOnMovesetChange
244:       end
245:       return
246:     end
247:     # Pokémon already knows the maximum number of moves; try to forget one to learn the new move
248:     pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} wants to learn {2}, but it already knows {3} moves.",
249:                           pkmnName, moveName, pkmn.numMoves.to_word))
250:     if pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("Should {1} forget a move to learn {2}?", pkmnName, moveName))
251:       loop do
252:         forgetMove = @scene.pbForgetMove(pkmn, newMove)
253:         if forgetMove >= 0
254:           oldMoveName = pkmn.moves[forgetMove].name
255:           pkmn.moves[forgetMove] = Pokemon::Move.new(newMove)   # Replaces current/total PP
256:           battler.moves[forgetMove] = Move.from_pokemon_move(self, pkmn.moves[forgetMove]) if battler
257:           pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("1, 2, and... ... ... Ta-da!")) { pbSEPlay("Battle ball drop") }
258:           pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} forgot how to use {2}. And...", pkmnName, oldMoveName))
259:           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} learned {2}!", pkmnName, moveName)) { pbSEPlay("Pkmn move learnt") }
260:           battler&.pbCheckFormOnMovesetChange
261:           break
262:         elsif pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("Give up on learning {1}?", moveName))
263:           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} did not learn {2}.", pkmnName, moveName))
264:           break
265:         end
266:       end
267:     else
268:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} did not learn {2}.", pkmnName, moveName))
269:     end
270:   end
271: end

135:   def pbMegaEvolve(idxBattler)
136:     battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
137:     return if !battler || !battler.pokemon
138:     return if !battler.hasMega? || battler.mega?
139:     $stats.mega_evolution_count += 1 if battler.pbOwnedByPlayer?
140:     trainerName = pbGetOwnerName(idxBattler)
141:     old_ability = battler.ability_id
142:     # Break Illusion
143:     if battler.hasActiveAbility?(:ILLUSION)
144:       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnBeingHit(battler.ability, nil, battler, nil, self)
145:     end

147:     case battler.pokemon.megaMessage
148:     when 1   # Rayquaza
149:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s fervent wish has reached {2}!", trainerName, battler.pbThis))
150:     else
151:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} is reacting to {3}'s {4}!",
152:                       battler.pbThis, battler.itemName, trainerName, pbGetMegaRingName(idxBattler)))
153:     end
154:     pbCommonAnimation("MegaEvolution", battler)
155:     battler.pokemon.makeMega
156:     battler.form = battler.pokemon.form
157:     battler.pbUpdate(true)
158:     @scene.pbChangePokemon(battler, battler.pokemon)
159:     @scene.pbRefreshOne(idxBattler)
160:     pbCommonAnimation("MegaEvolution2", battler)
161:     megaName = battler.pokemon.megaName
162:     megaName = _INTL("Mega {1}", battler.pokemon.speciesName) if nil_or_empty?(megaName)
163:     pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} has Mega Evolved into {2}!", battler.pbThis, megaName))
164:     side  = battler.idxOwnSide
165:     owner = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
166:     @megaEvolution[side][owner] = -2
167:     if battler.isSpecies?(:GENGAR) && battler.mega?
168:       battler.effects[PBEffects::Telekinesis] = 0
169:     end
170:     # Trigger ability
171:     battler.pbOnLosingAbility(old_ability)
172:     battler.pbTriggerAbilityOnGainingIt
173:     # Recalculate turn order

156:       validate species => [Symbol, self, String]
157:       validate form => Integer
158:       species = species.species if species.is_a?(self)
159:       species = species.to_sym if species.is_a?(String)

33:   # Triggers the event and calls all its event handlers.  Normally called only
34:   # by the code where the event occurred.

36:   # the event's parameters. If three or more arguments are given, this method

39:   # proc { |sender,arg0,arg1,...| }

112:   def pbThrowPokeBall(idxBattler, ball, catch_rate = nil, showPlayer = false)
113:     # Determine which Pokémon you're throwing the Poké Ball at
114:     battler = nil
115:     if opposes?(idxBattler)
116:       battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
117:     else
118:       battler = @battlers[idxBattler].pbDirectOpposing(true)
119:     end
120:     battler = battler.allAllies[0] if battler.fainted?
121:     # Messages
122:     itemName = GameData::Item.get(ball).name
123:     if battler.fainted?
124:       if itemName.starts_with_vowel?
125:         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} threw an {2}!", pbPlayer.name, itemName))
126:       else
127:         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} threw a {2}!", pbPlayer.name, itemName))
128:       end
129:       pbDisplay(_INTL("But there was no target..."))
130:       return
131:     end
132:     if itemName.starts_with_vowel?
133:       pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1} threw an {2}!", pbPlayer.name, itemName))
134:     else
135:       pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1} threw a {2}!", pbPlayer.name, itemName))
136:     end
137:     # Animation of opposing trainer blocking Poké Balls (unless it's a Snag Ball
138:     # at a Shadow Pokémon)
139:     if trainerBattle? && !(GameData::Item.get(ball).is_snag_ball? && battler.shadowPokemon?)
140:       @scene.pbThrowAndDeflect(ball, 1)
141:       pbDisplay(_INTL("The Trainer blocked your Poké Ball! Don't be a thief!"))
142:       return
143:     end
144:     # Calculate the number of shakes (4=capture)
145:     pkmn = battler.pokemon
146:     @criticalCapture = false
147:     numShakes = pbCaptureCalc(pkmn, battler, catch_rate, ball)
148:     PBDebug.log("[Threw Poké Ball] #{itemName}, #{numShakes} shakes (4=capture)")
149:     # Animation of Ball throw, absorb, shake and capture/burst out
150:     @scene.pbThrow(ball, numShakes, @criticalCapture, battler.index, showPlayer)
151:     # Outcome message
152:     case numShakes
153:     when 0
154:       pbDisplay(_INTL("Oh no! The Pokémon broke free!"))
155:       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onFailCatch(ball, self, battler)
156:     when 1
157:       pbDisplay(_INTL("Aww! It appeared to be caught!"))
158:       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onFailCatch(ball, self, battler)
159:     when 2
160:       pbDisplay(_INTL("Aargh! Almost had it!"))
161:       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onFailCatch(ball, self, battler)
162:     when 3
163:       pbDisplay(_INTL("Gah! It was so close, too!"))
164:       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onFailCatch(ball, self, battler)
165:     when 4
166:       pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("Gotcha! {1} was caught!", pkmn.name))
167:       @scene.pbThrowSuccess   # Play capture success jingle
168:       pbRemoveFromParty(battler.index, battler.pokemonIndex)
169:       # Gain Exp
170:       if Settings::GAIN_EXP_FOR_CAPTURE
171:         battler.captured = true
172:         pbGainExp
173:         battler.captured = false
174:       end
175:       battler.pbReset
176:       if pbAllFainted?(battler.index)
177:         @decision = (trainerBattle?) ? 1 : 4   # Battle ended by win/capture
178:       end
179:       # Modify the Pokémon's properties because of the capture
180:       if GameData::Item.get(ball).is_snag_ball?
181:         pkmn.owner = Pokemon::Owner.new_from_trainer(pbPlayer)
182:       end
183:       Battle::PokeBallEffects.onCatch(ball, self, pkmn)
184:       pkmn.poke_ball = ball
185:       pkmn.makeUnmega if pkmn.mega?
186:       pkmn.makeUnprimal
187:       pkmn.update_shadow_moves if pkmn.shadowPokemon?
188:       pkmn.record_first_moves
189:       # Reset form
190:       pkmn.forced_form = nil if MultipleForms.hasFunction?(pkmn.species, "getForm")
191:       @peer.pbOnLeavingBattle(self, pkmn, true, true)
192:       # Make the Poké Ball and data box disappear
193:       @scene.pbHideCaptureBall(idxBattler)
194:       # Save the Pokémon for storage at the end of battle
195:       @caughtPokemon.push(pkmn)
196:     end
197:     if numShakes != 4
198:       @first_poke_ball = ball if !@poke_ball_failed
199:       @poke_ball_failed = true
200:     end
201:   end

292:   def validate_compiled_pokemon(hash)
293:     # Convert base stats array to a hash
294:     if hash[:base_stats].is_a?(Array)
295:       new_stats = {}
296:       GameData::Stat.each_main do |s|
297:         new_stats[s.id] = (hash[:base_stats][s.pbs_order] || 1) if s.pbs_order >= 0
298:       end
299:       hash[:base_stats] = new_stats
300:     end
301:     # Convert EVs array to a hash
302:     if hash[:evs].is_a?(Array)
303:       new_evs = {}
304:       hash[:evs].each { |val| new_evs[val[0]] = val[1] }
305:       GameData::Stat.each_main { |s| new_evs[s.id] ||= 0 }
306:       hash[:evs] = new_evs
307:     end
308:     # Convert height and weight to integer values of tenths of a unit
309:     hash[:height] = [(hash[:height] * 10).round, 1].max if hash[:height]
310:     hash[:weight] = [(hash[:weight] * 10).round, 1].max if hash[:weight]
311:     # Ensure evolutions have a parameter if they need one (don't need to ensure
312:     # the parameter makes sense; that happens below)
313:     if hash[:evolutions]
314:       hash[:evolutions].each do |evo|
315:         FileLineData.setSection(hash[:id].to_s, "Evolution", "Evolution = #{evo[0]},#{evo[1]}")   # For error reporting
316:         param_type = GameData::Evolution.get(evo[1]).parameter
317:         next if evo[2] || param_type.nil?
318:         raise _INTL("Evolution method {1} requires a parameter, but none was given.", evo[1]) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
319:       end
320:     end
321:     # Record all evolutions as not being prevolutions
322:     if hash[:evolutions].is_a?(Array)
323:       hash[:evolutions].each { |evo| evo[3] = false }
324:     end
325:     # Remove duplicate types
326:     if hash[:types].is_a?(Array)
327:       hash[:types].uniq!
328:       hash[:types].compact!
329:     end

1: # The pbs_order value determines the order in which the stats are written in
2: # several PBS files, where base stats/IVs/EVs/EV yields are defined. Only stats
3: # which are yielded by the "each_main" method can have stat numbers defined in
4: # those places. The values of pbs_order defined below should start with 0 and
5: # increase without skipping any numbers.
6: module GameData
7:   class Stat
8:     attr_reader :id
9:     attr_reader :real_name
10:     attr_reader :real_name_brief
11:     attr_reader :type
12:     attr_reader :pbs_order
13: 
14:     DATA = {}
15: 
16:     extend ClassMethodsSymbols
17:     include InstanceMethods
18: 
19:     def self.load; end
20:     def self.save; end
21: 
22:     # These stats are defined in PBS files, and should have the :pbs_order
23:     # property.
24:     def self.each_main
25:       self.each { |s| yield s if [:main, :main_battle].include?(s.type) }
26:     end
27: 
28:     def self.each_main_battle
29:       self.each { |s| yield s if [:main_battle].include?(s.type) }
30:     end
31: 
32:     # These stats have associated stat stages in battle.
33:     def self.each_battle
34:       self.each { |s| yield s if [:main_battle, :battle].include?(s.type) }
35:     end
36: 
37:     def initialize(hash)
38:       @id              = hash[:id]
39:       @real_name       = hash[:name]       || "Unnamed"
40:       @real_name_brief = hash[:name_brief] || "None"
41:       @type            = hash[:type]       || :none
42:       @pbs_order       = hash[:pbs_order]  || -1
43:     end
44: 
45:     # @return [String] the translated name of this stat
46:     def name
47:       return _INTL(@real_name)
48:     end
49: 
50:     # @return [String] the translated brief name of this stat
51:     def name_brief
52:       return _INTL(@real_name_brief)
53:     end
54:   end
55: end

39: class PngAnimatedBitmap
40:   attr_accessor :frames
41: 
42:   # Creates an animated bitmap from a PNG file.
43:   def initialize(dir, filename, hue = 0)
44:     @frames       = []
45:     @currentFrame = 0
46:     @timer_start  = System.uptime
47:     panorama = RPG::Cache.load_bitmap(dir, filename, hue)
48:     if filename[/^\[(\d+)(?:,(\d+))?\]/]   # Starts with 1 or 2 numbers in brackets
49:       # File has a frame count
50:       numFrames = $1.to_i
51:       duration  = $2.to_i   # In 1/20ths of a second
52:       duration  = 5 if duration == 0
53:       raise "Invalid frame count in #{filename}" if numFrames <= 0
54:       raise "Invalid frame duration in #{filename}" if duration <= 0
55:       if panorama.width % numFrames != 0
56:         raise "Bitmap's width (#{panorama.width}) is not divisible by frame count: #{filename}"
57:       end
58:       @frame_duration = duration / 20.0
59:       subWidth = panorama.width / numFrames
60:       numFrames.times do |i|
61:         subBitmap = Bitmap.new(subWidth, panorama.height)
62:         subBitmap.blt(0, 0, panorama, Rect.new(subWidth * i, 0, subWidth, panorama.height))
63:         @frames.push(subBitmap)
64:       end
65:       panorama.dispose
66:     else
67:       @frames = [panorama]
68:     end
69:   end
70: 
71:   def dispose
72:     return if @disposed
73:     @frames.each { |f| f.dispose }
74:     @disposed = true
75:   end
76: 
77:   def disposed?
78:     return @disposed
79:   end
80: 
81:   def [](index)
82:     return @frames[index]
83:   end
84: 
85:   def width;  self.bitmap.width;  end
86:   def height; self.bitmap.height; end
87: 
88:   def bitmap
89:     return @frames[@currentFrame]
90:   end
91: 
92:   def currentIndex
93:     return @currentFrame
94:   end
95: 
96:   def length
97:     return @frames.length
98:   end
99: 
100:   # Actually returns the total number of 1/20ths of a second this animation lasts.
101:   def totalFrames
102:     return (@frame_duration * @frames.length * 20).to_i
103:   end
104: 
105:   def each
106:     @frames.each { |item| yield item }
107:   end
108: 
109:   def deanimate
110:     (1...@frames.length).each do |i|
111:       @frames[i].dispose
112:     end
113:     @frames = [@frames[0]]
114:     @currentFrame = 0
115:     @frame_duration = 0
116:     return @frames[0]
117:   end
118: 
119:   def copy
120:     x = self.clone
121:     x.frames = x.frames.clone
122:     x.frames.each_with_index { |frame, i| x.frames[i] = frame.copy }
123:     return x
124:   end
125: 
126:   def update
127:     return if disposed?
128:     if @frames.length > 1
129:       @currentFrame = ((System.uptime - @timer_start) / @frame_duration).to_i % @frames.length
130:     end
131:   end
132: end

143:     @disposed = false

4:   def compile_PBS_file_generic(game_data, *paths)
5:     if game_data.const_defined?(:OPTIONAL) && game_data::OPTIONAL
6:       return if paths.none? { |p| FileTest.exist?(p) }
7:     end
8:     game_data::DATA.clear
9:     schema = game_data.schema
10:     # Read from PBS file(s)
11:     paths.each do |path|
12:       compile_pbs_file_message_start(path)
13:       base_filename = game_data::PBS_BASE_FILENAME
14:       base_filename = base_filename[0] if base_filename.is_a?(Array)   # For Species
15:       file_suffix = File.basename(path, ".txt")[base_filename.length + 1, path.length] || ""
16:       File.open(path, "rb") do |f|
17:         FileLineData.file = path   # For error reporting
18:         # Read a whole section's lines at once, then run through this code.
19:         # contents is a hash containing all the XXX=YYY lines in that section, where
20:         # the keys are the XXX and the values are the YYY (as unprocessed strings).
21:         idx = 0
22:         pbEachFileSection(f, schema) do |contents, section_name|
23:           echo "." if idx % 100 == 0
24:           Graphics.update if idx % 500 == 0
25:           idx += 1
26:           data_hash = {
27:             :id              => section_name.to_sym,
28:             :pbs_file_suffix => file_suffix
29:           }
30:           # Go through schema hash of compilable data and compile this section
31:           schema.each_key do |key|
32:             FileLineData.setSection(section_name, key, contents[key])   # For error reporting
33:             if key == "SectionName"
34:               data_hash[schema[key][0]] = get_csv_record(section_name, schema[key])
35:               next
36:             end
37:             # Skip empty properties
38:             next if contents[key].nil?
39:             # Compile value for key
40:             if schema[key][1][0] == "^"
41:               contents[key].each do |val|
42:                 value = get_csv_record(val, schema[key])
43:                 value = nil if value.is_a?(Array) && value.empty?
44:                 data_hash[schema[key][0]] ||= []
45:                 data_hash[schema[key][0]].push(value)
46:               end
47:               data_hash[schema[key][0]].compact!
48:             else
49:               value = get_csv_record(contents[key], schema[key])
50:               value = nil if value.is_a?(Array) && value.empty?
51:               data_hash[schema[key][0]] = value
52:             end
53:           end
54:           # Validate and modify the compiled data
55:           yield false, data_hash if block_given?
56:           if game_data.exists?(data_hash[:id])
57:             raise _INTL("Section name '{1}' is used twice.", data_hash[:id]) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
58:           end
59:           # Add section's data to records
60:           game_data.register(data_hash)
61:         end
62:       end
63:       process_pbs_file_message_end
64:     end
65:     yield true, nil if block_given?
66:     # Save all data
67:     game_data.save
68:   end

384:   def cast_csv_value(value, schema, enumer = nil)
385:     case schema.downcase
386:     when "i"   # Integer
387:       if !value || !value[/^\-?\d+$/]
388:         raise _INTL("Field '{1}' is not an integer.", value) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
389:       end
390:       return value.to_i
391:     when "u"   # Positive integer or zero
392:       if !value || !value[/^\d+$/]
393:         raise _INTL("Field '{1}' is not a positive integer or 0.", value) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
394:       end
395:       return value.to_i
396:     when "v"   # Positive integer
397:       if !value || !value[/^\d+$/]
398:         raise _INTL("Field '{1}' is not a positive integer.", value) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
399:       end
400:       if value.to_i == 0
401:         raise _INTL("Field '{1}' must be greater than 0.", value) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
402:       end
403:       return value.to_i
404:     when "x"   # Hexadecimal number
405:       if !value || !value[/^[A-F0-9]+$/i]
406:         raise _INTL("Field '{1}' is not a hexadecimal number.", value) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
407:       end
408:       return value.hex
409:     when "f"   # Floating point number
410:       if !value || !value[/^\-?^\d*\.?\d*$/]
411:         raise _INTL("Field '{1}' is not a number.", value) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
412:       end
413:       return value.to_f
414:     when "b"   # Boolean
415:       return true if value && value[/^(?:1|TRUE|YES|Y)$/i]
416:       return false if value && value[/^(?:0|FALSE|NO|N)$/i]
417:       raise _INTL("Field '{1}' is not a Boolean value (true, false, 1, 0).", value) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
418:     when "n"   # Name
419:       if !value || !value[/^(?![0-9])\w+$/]
420:         raise _INTL("Field '{1}' must contain only letters, digits, and\nunderscores and can't begin with a number.", value) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
421:       end
422:     when "s"   # String
423:     when "q"   # Unformatted text
424:     when "m"   # Symbol
425:       if !value || !value[/^(?![0-9])\w+$/]
426:         raise _INTL("Field '{1}' must contain only letters, digits, and\nunderscores and can't begin with a number.", value) + "\n" + FileLineData.linereport
427:       end
428:       return value.to_sym
429:     when "e"   # Enumerable
430:       return checkEnumField(value, enumer)
431:     when "y"   # Enumerable or integer
432:       return value.to_i if value && value[/^\-?\d+$/]
433:       return checkEnumField(value, enumer)
434:     end
435:     return value
436:   end

1: # Category has the following effects:
2: #   - Determines the in-battle weather.
3: #   - Some abilities reduce the encounter rate in certain categories of weather.
4: #   - Some evolution methods check the current weather's category.
5: #   - The :Rain category treats the last listed particle graphic as a water splash rather
6: #     than a raindrop, which behaves differently.
7: #   - :Rain auto-waters berry plants.
8: # Delta values are per second.
9: # For the tone_proc, strength goes from 0 to RPG::Weather::MAX_SPRITES (60) and
10: # will typically be the maximum.
11: module GameData
12:   class Weather
13:     attr_reader :id
14:     attr_reader :id_number
15:     attr_reader :real_name
16:     attr_reader :category   # :None, :Rain, :Hail, :Sandstorm, :Sun, :Fog
17:     attr_reader :graphics   # [[particle file names], [tile file names]]
18:     attr_reader :particle_delta_x
19:     attr_reader :particle_delta_y
20:     attr_reader :particle_delta_opacity
21:     attr_reader :tile_delta_x
22:     attr_reader :tile_delta_y
23:     attr_reader :tone_proc
24: 
25:     DATA = {}
26: 
27:     extend ClassMethods
28:     include InstanceMethods
29: 
30:     def self.load; end
31:     def self.save; end
32: 
33:     def initialize(hash)
34:       @id                     = hash[:id]
35:       @id_number              = hash[:id_number]
36:       @real_name              = hash[:id].to_s                || "Unnamed"
37:       @category               = hash[:category]               || :None
38:       @particle_delta_x       = hash[:particle_delta_x]       || 0
39:       @particle_delta_y       = hash[:particle_delta_y]       || 0
40:       @particle_delta_opacity = hash[:particle_delta_opacity] || 0
41:       @tile_delta_x           = hash[:tile_delta_x]           || 0
42:       @tile_delta_y           = hash[:tile_delta_y]           || 0
43:       @graphics               = hash[:graphics]               || []
44:       @tone_proc              = hash[:tone_proc]
45:     end
46: 
47:     alias name real_name
48: 
49:     def has_particles?
50:       return @graphics[0] && @graphics[0].length > 0
51:     end
52: 
53:     def has_tiles?
54:       return @graphics[1] && @graphics[1].length > 0
55:     end
56: 
57:     def tone(strength)
58:       return (@tone_proc) ? @tone_proc.call(strength) : Tone.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
59:     end
60:   end
61: end

52:   challengedata = PokemonChallengeRules.new if !challengedata
53:   oldlevels = challengedata.adjustLevels($player.party, opponent.party)
54:   olditems  = $player.party.transform { |p| p.item_id }
55:   olditems2 = opponent.party.transform { |p| p.item_id }
56:   # Create the battle scene (the visual side of it)
57:   scene = BattleCreationHelperMethods.create_battle_scene
58:   # Create the battle class (the mechanics side of it)
59:   battle = challengedata.createBattle(scene, $player, opponent)
60:   battle.internalBattle = false
61:   # Set various other properties in the battle class
62:   BattleCreationHelperMethods.prepare_battle(battle)
63:   # Perform the battle itself
64:   decision = 0
65:   pbBattleAnimation(pbGetTrainerBattleBGM(opponent)) do
66:     pbSceneStandby { decision = battle.pbStartBattle }
67:   end
68:   Input.update
69:   # Restore both parties to their original levels
70:   challengedata.unadjustLevels($player.party, opponent.party, oldlevels)
71:   # Heal both parties and restore their original items
72:   $player.party.each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
73:     pkmn.heal
74:     pkmn.makeUnmega
75:     pkmn.makeUnprimal
76:     pkmn.item = olditems[i]
77:   end
78:   opponent.party.each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
79:     pkmn.heal
80:     pkmn.makeUnmega
81:     pkmn.makeUnprimal
82:     pkmn.item = olditems2[i]
83:   end
84:   # Save the record of the battle
85:   $game_temp.last_battle_record = nil
86:   if [1, 2, 5].include?(decision)   # if win, loss or draw
87:     $game_temp.last_battle_record = battle.pbDumpRecord
88:   end
89:   case decision

92:   when 2, 3, 5   # Lost, fled, draw
